p1: Cáirde Corrin is a voluntary group in Fermoy, Co. Cork. We work on the Glenabo and Corrin woodlands and the waterways that run through them.
p2: Glenabo-Corrin is an historical land where all living things can thrive in harmony with nature.
p3: We work to protect, restore and celebrate the environment, heritage and recreational use of our Glenabo-Corrin waterways, engaging with our local community, partnering with agencies, and taking action to ensure the rivers and their valleys flourish for future generations.
p4: Owner and manager of Glenabo and Corrin woods. All works on their land are subject to their consent and assessment procedures.
p5: Where sightings and survey records are submitted.
p6: Riverside and roadside sections of the proposed loop route.
p7: You do not need to be an ecologist. Most of what needs doing is walking, looking, recording and turning up. Get in touch and we will tell you what is happening next.
